appearance.subtle: There is something slightly wrong about how their skin settles when they move.
appearance.obvious: Their flesh moves a half-beat behind them, settling and re-settling like something under tension.
appearance.extreme: They ripple. A tap on the shoulder travels across their whole torso and comes back, and nothing about the way they stand is quite still.

description: Your connective tissue has gone elastic. Blunt force spreads out and goes nowhere. Anything sharp goes in easy.
drawbacks: Blades find you much too easily
name: Rubberized Flesh
